brief:
Israeli occupation forces invaded multiple towns and cities across the West Bank before dawn Saturday, breaking into homes and detaining Palestinians, IMEMC News reported. The raids included assaults on residents and the use of live ammunition and gas bombs.

The predawn operations targeted communities throughout the occupied territory, with forces conducting home invasions across several locations. Details on the number of those detained and the specific communities affected were not immediately clear.
dek: Israeli occupation forces invaded towns and cities across the occupied West Bank before dawn on Saturday, breaking into homes, assaulting and detaining Palestinians, and firing live rounds and gas bombs.
title: Israeli forces raid West Bank towns, detain Palestinians
